description: This file contains unit tests for the UserRoleManagerService class in the OrangeHRM project. It verifies the behavior of methods related to obtaining and validating user role manager classes, as well as handling different scenarios such as class existence, inheritance, and logged-in user state.

classes.name: InvalidUserRoleManager
classes.description: A dummy class not inheriting from AbstractUserRoleManager, used to test invalid class handling.

classes.name: UnitTestUserRoleManager
classes.description: A mock implementation of AbstractUserRoleManager for testing purposes.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment by creating the kernel.

methods.name: testGetUserRoleManagerClassName
methods.description: Tests retrieval of the user role manager class name from configuration.

methods.name: testGetUserRoleManagerExistingClass
methods.description: Tests obtaining a user role manager instance when a valid class is specified and exists.

methods.name: testGetUserRoleManagerInvalidClass
methods.description: Verifies that an invalid class (not subclass of AbstractUserRoleManager) throws a service exception.

methods.name: testGetUserRoleManagerNonExistingClass
methods.description: Checks behavior when the specified user role manager class does not exist.

methods.name: testGetUserRoleManagerNoLoggedInUser
methods.description: Ensures correct handling when no logged-in user is found.
